title: Aeon Circuit connected maps, worldbuilding, interactive events, menus and combat research, 2026-11-15
summary: Owner-requested source-grounded research and integration blueprint. One Ghost Signal-rendered persistent world composed of discrete 32x32 four-cardinal maps with explicit portal graph, atomic transitions and per-map save deltas. Shared typed event conditions/effects drive doors, salvage, Echo dialogue, quest knowledge, security and encounter outcomes. Original Ghost Signal-styled JRPG menus share touch/gamepad/keyboard focus and transactional item/equipment actions. Compare PSIV-style whole-party command planning with verified sequential combat; use authored telegraphed encounters. Prioritize two connected maps with real travel/reload before expanding to a 6-9-map expedition. Proposals are NOT evidence of implemented production maps or final physical Moto G tests. Public archive excludes private Revision 4.10 revelations.
